tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek philos, 'loving', + hippos, 'horse' — 'lover of horses'. Its root is Greek philos + hippos. Philip the Apostle; Philip the Evangelist. Philip is a Greek name meaning “Lover of horses”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
